title: The order screen words the new fulfilment and resolution refusals of the wave A SQL as «تعذّر الحفظ. حاول مرة أخرى.»: a dispute-stopped line, a line under an in-flight refund and a reversed payment all read as a transient failure
evidence: The working tree's uncommitted 20261007110000_fable_audit_operations.sql makes fulfillment_update answer {ok:false, code:'REFUND_IN_FLIGHT'|'FULFILLMENT_STOPPED', itemIds} (lines 581-583 and 609-611), and 20261007100000_fable_audit_payments.sql makes order_resolve answer {ok:false, code:'PAYMENT_REVERSED'} (line 1005). The screen's table has neither: REFUSALS.fulfil = {NOT_FOUND, ORDER_NOT_PAID, INVALID_ITEMS, BAD_TRANSITION, ITEM_REFUNDED, DEDICATION_NOT_DONE} and REFUSALS.resolve = {NOT_FOUND, STOCK_UNAVAILABLE, REFUND_IN_FLIGHT} (admin-orders.ts:606-621); refusalText falls back to `SAVE_FAILED` = 'تعذّر الحفظ. حاول مرة أخرى.' (:652), and OrderView.refused appends the line names (OrderView.tsx:141-151).
impact: Once the M1b/M1a migrations land without a client change: an operations member asked to ship a line the owner stopped with «إيقاف الشحن» (they cannot see disputes, which are owner-only) is told to try again, every time, with no reason; the likely next step is to ship the parcel by hand outside the system, which is the chargeback loss DB-OPS-02 was fixed to prevent. The owner who presses «تأكيد إكمال الطلب» on an order whose money went back at Moyasar is told to retry instead of to record the external refund, so the order stays in «تحتاج حلًا».
proposed_fix: Add to REFUSALS.fulfil: FULFILLMENT_STOPPED «أوقف قرار نزاع شحن هذه العناصر؛ لا تُشحن.» and REFUND_IN_FLIGHT «استرداد قيد المعالجة يشمل هذه العناصر؛ أعد المحاولة بعد دقائق.»; to REFUSALS.resolve: PAYMENT_REVERSED «أُعيد مبلغ هذه الدفعة لدى Moyasar؛ سجّل الاسترداد الخارجي ولا تُكمل الطلب.»; one unit case each in tests/unit/admin-orders.test.ts. Ship it in the same round as the migrations (F2b).
prior_overlap: Client half of this audit's wave A fixes M1b-1 (DB-POST-01), M1b-2 (DB-OPS-02) and M1a-7 (order_resolve PAYMENT_REVERSED); the rulings name no F2b item for these codes.

title: The order view ignores the per-item `stopped` flag the new order_detail sends to every staff role: a dispute-stopped line stays choosable for «تم الشحن» and nothing on the screen says it is stopped
evidence: 20261007110000_fable_audit_operations.sql:247-248 adds `'stopped', i.id = any (v_stopped)` to each item of order_detail "so operations see why it cannot ship". The parser drops it (itemOf in admin-orders.ts:256-274 has no `stopped`), and the fulfilment table decides choosability only by refunds: `const choosable = !(entry.state === 'preparing' && item?.fullyRefunded === true)` (OrderView.tsx:689); `fulfil()` filters the same way (:242-245). The disputes section that would explain it is owner-only (`d.disputes !== null`, :935).
impact: After the migration, operations (and the owner) see a stopped line as an ordinary line to ship, tick it, press «تم الشحن» and get a refusal (see ADMIN-COMMERCE-01); the only signal the M1b-2 fix built for operations never reaches the screen.
proposed_fix: Parse `stopped: bool(o.stopped)` in itemOf (tolerate absence only until the migration is applied, or ship both together), treat a stopped preparing line like a fully refunded one in `choosable` and `fulfil()`, and add «أوقف قرار نزاع شحنه» beside its name; one e2e assertion in orders-admin.spec.ts.
prior_overlap: Client half of wave A M1b-2 (DB-OPS-02 = P08-CKPT-10).

title: The owner's refund of a payment whose chargeback was lost is refused with the bare «تعذّر تنفيذ الإجراء.»: refunds.ts has no sentence for the new CHARGEBACK_RECORDED
evidence: 20261007110000_fable_audit_operations.sql:927-938 makes refund_request answer {ok:false, code:'CHARGEBACK_RECORDED'}. refunds.ts:95-105 REFUSALS has no entry, so `refusal()` answers `[409, 'تعذّر تنفيذ الإجراء.']` (:108); RefundView shows the function's message as it is (admin-money.ts:302 `message || GENERIC`).
impact: The owner who tries to refund an order whose chargeback he recorded as against the seller reads a generic failure with no reason; he may retry, or refund the buyer by hand in Moyasar's dashboard, paying the money back twice (the very case M1b-5 refuses).
proposed_fix: Add CHARGEBACK_RECORDED: [409, 'سُجّل اعتراض بطاقة على البائع لهذه الدفعة، فالمبلغ أُعيد عبر البنك؛ لا يُسترد مرة ثانية.'] to REFUSALS in refunds.ts, with a unit case in tests/unit/payments or admin-refunds.
prior_overlap: Client-facing half of wave A M1b-5 (DB-POST-02).

title: The statistics line «دفعات قيد المراجعة: مفتوحة n، مبالغها …، المسترد منها …» pairs a count of the OPEN review payments with the amounts of ALL review payments that arrived in the range
evidence: commerceLines: `دفعات قيد المراجعة: مفتوحة ${formatNumber(review.open)}، مبالغها ${formatMoney(review.captured)}، المسترد منها ${formatMoney(review.refunded)}`. owner_commerce_stats (20261002170000_stats_disputes.sql:352-362): `'open', count(*) filter (where pr.closed_at is null), 'captured', coalesce(sum(pr.amount_halalas), 0), 'refunded', ...` over every review payment `created_at` in the range, open or closed; the total count of those payments is not returned at all.
impact: Three review payments of 1,000 SAR arrived this month, the owner refunded and closed all three: the screen says «دفعات قيد المراجعة: مفتوحة 0، مبالغها 3,000.00 ر.س، المسترد منها 3,000.00 ر.س». With one still open it says «مفتوحة 1، مبالغها 3,000.00 ر.س», which reads as 3,000 SAR still waiting for review. The owner misjudges how much money is held in review.
proposed_fix: Either return `count` (all) beside `open` and word it «دفعات المراجعة الواردة: n، المفتوحة منها m، مبالغها …، المسترد منها …», or make `captured` the open ones' amounts and word it «مبالغ المفتوحة». One unit case pinning the words to the SQL's meaning.
prior_overlap: none (round 11c's brief prescribed the words; no audit compared them with the SQL's filter)

title: A review payment in another currency (an invoice made outside the site on the same Moyasar account) is shown, summed and refunded as riyals: no screen shows its currency
evidence: apply_verified_payment records an unmapped invoice's charged payment with the payment's own currency and minor units: `values (v_pay_id, p_invoice_id, p_mode, v_amount, v_currency, ...'UNMAPPED_INVOICE'...)` (20261007100000_fable_audit_payments.sql:323-324; payments.ts:315-321 applies any webhook payment whose invoice it can fetch). reviewOf parses `currency` (admin-orders.ts:309) but neither screen draws it: ReconciliationView.tsx:324 `formatMoney(review.amount)` and :325 `formatMoney(review.refunded)` append « ر.س», the refund form labels its field «ر.س» and reads riyals with two decimals (RefundView.tsx:381, admin-money.ts:145). Moyasar's amount is 'in the smallest currency unit', e.g. '1.00 KWD = 1000' (docs.moyasar.com/api/invoices/01-create-invoice).
impact: If the account is ever used for anything else (EF-MONEY-01 leaves that to the owner), a USD 10.00 payment appears as «10.00 ر.س» and a KWD 10.000 one as «100.00 ر.س»; the owner judges and refunds it as riyals (the refund is numerically what the screen shows, so the money moved is right, but he cannot tell what it is), and the statistics add its minor units to the riyal figures.
proposed_fix: Show `review.currency` beside the amount on both screens (a «العملة» fact, dir=ltr) and, when it is not SAR, say «بعملة أخرى؛ راجعها في لوحة Moyasar» and leave out the refund form (refund it from the dashboard and record it with «تسجيل استرداد خارجي»).
prior_overlap: none; related to EF-MONEY-01 (a shared Moyasar account is the owner's call)

title: When a refund's reply cannot be read, the screen keeps the confirmation and its idempotency key for a safe repeat, but tells the owner «حدّث الصفحة», the one action that throws that key away
evidence: `export const BAD_REPLY = 'تعذّر قراءة الرد؛ حدّث الصفحة.'` is what readRefundReply says for an unreadable answer, with `keep: true` because 'the refund may exist' (admin-money.ts:299 and :309). RefundView keeps `frozen` and `kept` only in component state and a ref (RefundView.tsx:246-248, :300-304), so a reload loses both (round 11b's own open risk). The repeat that is safe is pressing «تأكيد الاسترداد» again, which re-sends the same key and gets the stored refund (keyFor, admin-money.ts:221-223; refund_request's duplicate branch).
impact: Order of 100 SAR, the owner refunds 30, the reply is unreadable (a proxy body, a 2xx without the shape). He follows the sentence and reloads; the confirmation and key are gone. The page now lists the refund, but if he takes the sentence to mean it failed and types 30 again, a new key is minted and the server, seeing 70 SAR still refundable, sends a second 30 SAR refund: only EXCEEDS_BALANCE or REFUND_IN_FLIGHT would have stopped it, and neither applies to a partial refund that already settled.
proposed_fix: Give the refund readers their own sentence for this case, e.g. «تعذّر قراءة الرد، وقد يكون الاسترداد تم. اضغط «تأكيد الاسترداد» مرة أخرى: لن يتكرر، أو راجع جدول الاستردادات قبل أي استرداد جديد.», and keep «حدّث الصفحة» only where nothing is kept (recheck, dispute, the order screens' parsers).
prior_overlap: R11B-6 introduced BAD_REPLY with keep: true for this case; the sentence was never revisited against the 'reload loses the key' risk recorded in round 11b.

title: The dispute form on the reconciliation screen silently loses «سحب الملفات» and «إيقاف الشحن» when the order's lines cannot be read, or when an earlier form's read answers last
evidence: orderLines turns every failure (an rpc error, a parse error, no row) into null (ReconciliationView.tsx:68-82), and toggleForm stores whatever answer comes back last, keyed by order number: `const lines = await orderLines(order); setFormLines({ order, lines })` (:199-204), with no check that the form is still the one that asked. linesOf answers 'loading' whenever formLines names another order (:230-231). DisputeForm maps both 'loading' and null to `known = null` and offers only `['none', 'entitlement_kept']` (DisputeForm.tsx:73-76, admin-money.ts:383-386), and it draws nothing that says the lines are loading or could not be read.
impact: The owner records a lost chargeback from «إضافة متابعة» to stop a parcel: if the lines read failed (a dropped connection), or he opened another reference's form first and its read answered after this one's, the decision list has no «إيقاف الشحن» and no sentence says why. He records «بلا إجراء» and the goods ship, or he gives up; nothing tells him to retry.
proposed_fix: Keep a token per open form and ignore an answer for a form no longer open; let DisputeForm say «يحمّل البنود...» while 'loading' and «تعذّر قراءة بنود الطلب؛ أغلق النموذج وافتحه من جديد أو سجّل من صفحة الطلب.» when the order has a number but its lines are null.
prior_overlap: R11B uncovered list names the reconciliation dispute form's line reading as untested; no audit reported the race or the silent narrowing.

title: The refund confirmation never says what the ledger does beside moving money: a line refunded in full loses its file for good, and an unshipped unit does not go back to stock
evidence: The confirmation shows the total, the lines and REFUND_WARNING «سيُعاد المبلغ إلى وسيلة دفع العميل عبر Moyasar، ولا يمكن التراجع عنه.» only (RefundView.tsx:327-339, admin-money.ts:32). On success refund_succeed revokes the entitlement of every item whose refunded total equals what it cost, and of every item once the attempt is fully refunded (20261007110000_fable_audit_operations.sql:740-748, contract §6 'Success effects'), and 'Stock is never touched by a refund' (contract §6; docs/operations.md:884-894 tells the owner to raise the stock by hand). Nothing in the refund form, its confirmation or its success sentence («تمت إعادة …») says either.
impact: A goodwill refund of a digital book's full price (a typo in the PDF, a late delivery) silently ends the buyer's downloads; it cannot be given back from the admin. A refund of a physical copy that never shipped leaves the copy on the shelf but out of stock until the owner remembers the runbook, so it stays unsellable.
proposed_fix: In the confirmation, list the consequences computed from the frozen lines: «سيُسحب ملف: <line>» for a digital line whose amount equals its remainder (or every digital line when the total equals what is left of the order), and «لا يعود المخزون تلقائيًا؛ عدّل مخزون <SKU> بعد الاسترداد» for a physical line still being prepared. Whether a full goodwill refund should keep the file is a policy question for the owner.
prior_overlap: none (operations.md documents the stock rule; no screen carries it)

title: Store forms still never mark the offending field invalid: AUDIT-2 X-A11Y-RTL-11 was fixed for the summary and the Save button only
evidence: The only aria-invalid in the store's form code is the money field's own (FieldInput.tsx:349). TableForm renders the problems as a role=status list and focuses it from an aria-disabled Save (TableForm.tsx:362-396), but the text, slug, number and date inputs it draws through FieldInput (:349-357) get neither aria-invalid nor an aria-describedby pointing at their problem (FieldInput.tsx text input: only the hint's id; number and date inputs: none). X-A11Y-RTL-11's fix text asked for both: 'add aria-invalid and aria-describedby to the offending input for text fields as MoneyFieldInput does'.
impact: A screen-reader user who blanks a variant's title or types a SKU with a space hears the list once when pressing «حفظ», then tabs back through the form with no field announced as invalid and no message read with it; with a long variant form (preorder fields, stock, threshold) he has to find the field by position.
proposed_fix: Pass TableForm's per-field messages down (problems keyed by field name) and render each under its input with an id, setting aria-invalid and aria-describedby on that input; the money field already does this and can share the pattern.
prior_overlap: AUDIT-2 X-A11Y-RTL-11 (holds only partly); AUDIT-1 X3.4

title: A digital variant can be put on sale with no paid file, and the variant form neither refuses nor warns: buyers pay for an instant download that does not exist yet
evidence: The panel says only «لا يوجد ملف بعد» (NO_FILE, VariantCommerce.tsx:246-247) and appears only after the variant's first save (TableForm.tsx:407-416), while «معروض للبيع» can be ticked in that first save. Nothing in checkout looks at the file: finance.availability answers null (unlimited) for a digital variant that is not a preorder (20261002100000_payment_core.sql:462-467), and no checkout function reads digital_asset (grep of the migrations). The buyer learns it only from the receipt: «الملف الرقمي: سنضيفه إلى صفحة طلبك عند توفره.» (supabase/functions/_shared/email.ts:390).
impact: The owner creates a digital edition, ticks «معروض للبيع» and saves, then has to come back to upload (or forgets): every sale in between is a paid order whose buyer expected a download and gets «بانتظار الملف»; the waiting-file path was built for digital preorders, whose product page says so before payment.
proposed_fix: In VariantCommerce, when the saved variant is digital, not a preorder, has no file and the form's «معروض للبيع» is on, show an alert line «هذا الخيار معروض للبيع بلا ملف: من يشتريه ينتظر حتى ترفع الملف. ارفع الملف أو أوقفه.»; optionally refuse saving `enabled` for such a variant in variants.ts validate (the panel knows the file). Whether the store should refuse it is the owner's call.

title: Changing a digital variant that has a paid file to «ورقي» or «موقّع» fails with the bare «تحقق من القيم.»: the form does not know the table's file rule and the admin has no way to remove the file
evidence: product_variants carries `check (fulfillment = 'digital' or digital_asset is null)` (20260927160000_catalog_and_checkout.sql:149). variants.ts validate checks only the preorder fields (:173-185) and toRow sends the new fulfillment with a stock (:186-202); the update fails with 23514, which TableForm words as CHECK_MESSAGE «تحقق من القيم.» naming no field (TableForm.tsx:230). Only paid_asset_set writes digital_asset (the column's grant was revoked from authenticated, payment_core.sql:69) and no admin action clears it.
impact: The owner who mis-set a variant's type after uploading its file (or wants a printed edition under the same SKU) gets a generic refusal he cannot act on; this is the S11.3 'no field named' outcome for the one variant check P08 made unreachable from the form.
proposed_fix: In the variant form, when the saved variant has a file, refuse a change of «نوع التنفيذ» before the call with «لهذا الخيار ملف مدفوع؛ أنشئ خيارًا جديدًا للنسخة الورقية.» (TableForm knows the saved type; the file state is in VariantCommerce's reading or variant_admin_info).
prior_overlap: AUDIT-1 S11.3 (validation parity) for a check the P08 file flow made relevant

title: The in-progress order_resolve fix reads Moyasar's status 'refunded' as a full reversal, but Moyasar (and the emulator) set it after a PARTIAL refund: refunding the missing line, as the screen tells the owner to, then makes «إكمال الطلب» impossible
evidence: order_resolve (uncommitted M1a-7): `if v_attempt.provider_status in ('refunded', 'voided') or v_attempt.provider_refunded_halalas >= v_attempt.captured_halalas then return ... 'PAYMENT_REVERSED'` (:1002-1006). apply_verified_payment writes the fetched status onto the attempt's own payment whatever follows (`provider_status = v_status`, same migration, step 4 at :356-362), and a `payment_refunded` webhook or the owner's «أعد الفحص» runs it. Moyasar: after a refund with an amount below the charge 'The payment status changes to `refunded`' (https://docs.moyasar.com/docs/guides/payment-operations/index.md, fetched 2026-10-07); the project's emulator does the same by default (`partialRefundKeepsPaid: false`, tests/support/moyasar-emulator.ts:220 and :753). The screen's own STOCK_UNAVAILABLE sentence sends the owner down this path: «المخزون لا يكفي لعنصر في هذا الطلب؛ عدّل المخزون أو أعد مبلغ العنصر أولًا.» (admin-orders.ts:619). The new integration case 'A part refunded at the provider is no reversal' passes only because its helper keeps `status: 'paid'` with `refunded: r.total - 1` (tests/integration/order-operations.test.ts:177-185 and the PAYMENT_REVERSED case), a payment Moyasar does not produce.
impact: A paid order whose second line was out of stock: the owner refunds that line, Moyasar marks the payment 'refunded', the webhook records it, and every «تأكيد إكمال الطلب» on the remaining line answers PAYMENT_REVERSED (worded «تعذّر الحفظ. حاول مرة أخرى.» until ADMIN-COMMERCE-01 is fixed). The paid line is never committed, shipped or delivered through the system; the order stays in «تحتاج حلًا» until the owner refunds everything.
proposed_fix: Decide reversal by money, not by the status word: `if v_attempt.provider_status = 'voided' or v_attempt.provider_refunded_halalas >= v_attempt.captured_halalas` (a full refund already reaches the second test). Make the test's partial case use `status: 'refunded'` with a partial `refunded`, as Moyasar documents, and keep E02 run 6 recording the status after a partial refund.
proof_recipe: Local stack with the migration applied. For a paid_needs_resolution order P (total T, captured T) whose paying payment is PAY on invoice INV: `select public.apply_verified_payment('INV', jsonb_build_object('id','PAY','status','refunded','amount',T,'currency','SAR','refunded',T-1000,'invoiceId','INV'), jsonb_build_object('id','INV','status','paid','amount',T,'currency','SAR'), 'test', null, null);` then, as the owner (set request.jwt.claims or through the Data API), `select public.order_resolve('P');` with the stock raised. Wrong result: `{"ok": false, "code": "PAYMENT_REVERSED"}`; expected: `{"ok": true, ...}`. Sandbox (E02 run 6): a partial refund's fetched payment shows status 'refunded' with refunded below amount.
prior_overlap: Introduced by this audit's wave A fix M1a-7 (order_resolve PAYMENT_REVERSED); VENDOR-PAY wave B noted the partial-refund status fact without tracing it to order_resolve.

title: «إكمال الطلب» moves the focus onto «تأكيد إكمال الطلب», so a double or held Enter completes the order: the R11B-4 rule was applied to the refund confirmation only
evidence: `useEffect(() => { if (confirming) confirmRef.current?.focus() }, [confirming])` (OrderView.tsx:130-132) puts the focus on the button that calls order_resolve (:926-930) as soon as «إكمال الطلب» (:917-925) is pressed. Enter activates a button on keydown and repeats while held. R11B-4 found the same pattern on «تأكيد الاسترداد» and the fix moved the initial focus to the confirmation group (RefundView.tsx:254-263); the order screen's own two-step was not changed.
impact: An owner who presses Enter twice, or holds it, on «إكمال الطلب» commits the order without reading «يُخصم المخزون للعناصر غير المعادة، وتُمنح الملفات، ويُرسل إيصال.»: stock is taken, files are granted and the buyer is mailed a receipt, none of which the admin can undo.
proposed_fix: Focus the section's sentence or a tabIndex=-1 group (as RefundView does) when `confirming` turns on, not the confirm button; update the e2e that asserts the focus on «تأكيد إكمال الطلب».
prior_overlap: P08 R11B-4 (same pattern, fixed for refunds only); round 11a accepted the focus on the confirm button before that ruling.

title: After the switch to live, a test attempt the job parked (MODE_CHANGED) stays on «المطابقة» and in «تحتاج مطابقة» for ever: its only control, «أعد الفحص», answers «لم نجد محاولة الدفع هذه.»
evidence: The uncommitted M1a-6 parks other-mode attempts (`last_error = 'MODE_CHANGED'`, status expired, 20261007100000_fable_audit_payments.sql:637-641), lists them with reason MODE_CHANGED while `a.status not in ('paid','review') and a.provider_invoice_id is not null` (:786-788) and counts them in orders_alerts.unverifiedAttempts (20261007110000_fable_audit_operations.sql:424). The only exit is an answered prompt (M1b-13, :1968). The screen offers «أعد الفحص» (ReconciliationView.tsx:285-292) → payment-recheck → payment_attempt_ref, which reads `where a.id = p_attempt and a.environment = p_mode` (20261002100000_payment_core.sql:1387) and answers NOT_FOUND, worded «لم نجد محاولة الدفع هذه.» (admin.ts:517). The reason itself is drawn as the raw code (RECONCILIATION_REASON_LABELS has no MODE_CHANGED, admin-orders.ts:90-95). The migration's own comment says 'a person settles it from the dashboard', but no screen can record that.
impact: Every sandbox attempt still pending when PAYMENTS_MODE becomes live (E02's last runs) sits on the owner's reconciliation screen and in the home's «تحتاج مطابقة» permanently; the count never returns to zero, so a real unverified payment or external refund later hides among them.
proposed_fix: Give the owner a way to file a parked attempt after checking the dashboard (an `attempt_dismiss` like `event_dismiss`, clearing MODE_CHANGED with an audit row), offer it instead of «أعد الفحص» for MODE_CHANGED rows, and label the reason «من وضع الدفع الآخر؛ راجعها في لوحة Moyasar».
proof_recipe: Local stack with the migrations: insert a test-mode order and a 'pending' attempt with an invoice id and next_check_at in the past; `select public.payment_reconcile_claim('live');` (the claim parks it); as the owner `select public.reconciliation_list();` lists it with reasons ['MODE_CHANGED']; call the admin function `payment-recheck` with its attemptId while PAYMENTS_MODE=live: 404 NOT_FOUND; the row is still listed and `orders_alerts().unverifiedAttempts` still counts it.
prior_overlap: Attempt counterpart of wave A CONTRACT-04 (other-mode refunds, open); introduced by this audit's M1a-6 listing.

title: The two reason codes the wave A SQL adds have no Arabic word: a review payment refunded before it settled shows «REFUNDED_BEFORE_SETTLE», a parked attempt «MODE_CHANGED»
evidence: payment_reviews' reason check gains 'REFUNDED_BEFORE_SETTLE' (20261007100000_fable_audit_payments.sql:28-33, set at :410) and reconciliation_list's reasons gain 'MODE_CHANGED' (:786-788). REVIEW_REASON_LABELS (admin-orders.ts:74-81) and RECONCILIATION_REASON_LABELS (:90-95) know neither, so Enum draws the English code `dir="ltr"` on the order view (OrderView.tsx:551-553) and the reconciliation screen (ReconciliationView.tsx:276-281, :321-323).
impact: The owner reads English codes on the two screens that decide what to do with money; he cannot tell that a REFUNDED_BEFORE_SETTLE payment needs no refund (it went back already) or what MODE_CHANGED asks of him.
proposed_fix: Add REFUNDED_BEFORE_SETTLE «أُعيد كاملًا قبل التسوية» and MODE_CHANGED «من وضع الدفع الآخر» to the two tables, with a unit case each, in the same round as the migration.
prior_overlap: Client half of wave A M1a-1 / M1a-5b and M1a-6.

title: A refund carries nothing of what the owner saw, so a stale tab or a second owner refunds the same money again: the server bounds only the balance, never the view the form was built from
evidence: refundBody sends {action, orderId, attemptId, amount, reason, allocation[, returnId]} (admin-money.ts:195-203); the remainders it was computed from (`item.total - item.refunded`, :105) are not sent. refundCreateSchema accepts exactly those keys (refunds.ts:60-73) and refund_request decides only by REFUND_IN_FLIGHT, the provider's total, EXCEEDS_BALANCE and refund_allocation_ok against the current ledger (20261007110000_fable_audit_operations.sql:888-952). The screen re-reads only after its own actions (OrderView.tsx:158-162, :221); nothing refreshes a form opened earlier.
impact: A buyer complains; Anas refunds 30 SAR of a 100 SAR line from his phone, and the owner, whose laptop tab was opened before, refunds 30 SAR for the same complaint: the laptop's form still offers 100, the server sees 70 left and sends a second 30 SAR refund through Moyasar. The same happens to one owner with two tabs, or after a reload that followed the «حدّث الصفحة» advice (ADMIN-COMMERCE-06). The money cannot be taken back from the buyer.
proposed_fix: Send the ledger state the form was built from (`expectedRefunded`: the attempt's confirmed refunded total, or for a review payment its `refunded`) in the body and the request hash, and have refund_request answer a new refusal STALE («تغيّر المسترد منذ فتحت هذه الصفحة؛ راجع الاستردادات ثم أعد المحاولة.») when it differs; the client re-reads on STALE. Idempotent repeats keep working because the key and the body are unchanged.
proof_recipe: Local stack with the emulator: open the same paid order (one line of 100 SAR) in two signed-in owner tabs; in tab A refund 30 (step-up) and see «تمت إعادة 30.00 ر.س.»; in tab B, without reloading, type 30 in the same line and confirm: the second refund-create answers status succeeded and the order's refunded total is 60.00.
prior_overlap: R11B noted 'remainders shown meanwhile can be stale' as an accepted risk, relying on REFUND_IN_FLIGHT and EXCEEDS_BALANCE; neither stops a sequential partial refund.

title: The commerce settings screen tells an enrolled owner to enable his authenticator when the factor list merely failed to load
evidence: On STEP_UP_REQUIRED: `const { data } = await supabase.auth.mfa.listFactors(); const verified = data?.totp.find(...); if (!verified) { setNeedsEnrollment(true); return }` (CommerceSettingsForm.tsx:110-116): the call's `error` is ignored, so a failed read is treated as 'no factor'. The money screens' useStepUp tells the two apart ('failed' becomes «تعذّر الاتصال بالخادم.», RefundView.tsx:91-92, admin-money.ts:259).
impact: On a dropped connection the owner who presses «افتح الشراء», «اعتماد السياسات المنشورة» or «حفظ» is told «يلزم تفعيل تطبيق المصادقة أولًا. اذهب إلى صفحة الأمان.», finds it already enabled there, and does not know why the store did not open.
proposed_fix: Read `error` from listFactors and, when set, show «تعذّر الاتصال بالخادم. حاول مرة أخرى.» instead of the enrolment sentence (or reuse useStepUp from RefundView).

title: The order view offers «إعادة المبلغ» on a payment Moyasar already shows voided: the refund is sent, refused, and worded as a gateway refusal with no pointer to «تسجيل استرداد خارجي»
evidence: `const refundTarget = owner && order.status !== 'refunded' ? (d.attempts.find((attempt) => attempt.status === 'paid') ?? null) : null` (OrderView.tsx:396) ignores `attempt.providerStatus`, which the card shows raw («حالة المزوّد: voided», :505). refund_request does not look at the provider status (20261007110000_fable_audit_operations.sql:888-952), so the row is reserved and the provider call is made; Moyasar refunds only paid and captured payments (https://docs.moyasar.com/docs/guides/payment-operations/index.md), its 4xx becomes REFUND_REFUSED (refunds.ts:180-182) and the owner reads REFUND_FAILED «رفضت بوابة الدفع الاسترداد؛ لم يُخصم شيء.» (admin-money.ts:31). The reconciliation screen lists the same attempt under PROVIDER_STATUS with the external record, but the order view gives no such hint.
impact: After a void made in Moyasar's dashboard, the owner who opens the order to refund the buyer gets a refusal that blames the gateway, may retry or refund by other means, and the void stays unrecorded (the order still «مدفوع», entitlements and shipping still live) until he finds the reconciliation screen.
proposed_fix: When the paying attempt's providerStatus is 'voided', replace the refund form with «ألغيت هذه الدفعة لدى Moyasar؛ سجّل ذلك هنا» and the «تسجيل استرداد خارجي» control (refund_record_external records a void as the whole unrefunded amount).
prior_overlap: Related to wave A EF-MONEY-15 (refusal reasons dropped) and the wave A recheck-after-void finding; neither covers the order view offering the refund form.
